const patch="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+import json, time
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+CAMERAS = ['top', 'oblique', 'side', 'front']
+
+def world_cloud(obs, cam):
+    d = obs.depth[cam][-1].astype(float)
+    info = obs.meta['cameras'][cam]
+    C = np.asarray(info['cam2world_gl'], float)
+    K = np.asarray(info['intrinsic_cv'], float)
+    h, w = d.shape
+    v, u = np.mgrid[:h, :w]
+    pc = np.stack(((u-K[0,2])*d/K[0,0], -(v-K[1,2])*d/K[1,1], -d, np.ones_like(d)), -1)
+    return (pc @ C.T)[...,:3]
+
+def hand_center(obs):
+    im = obs.last['top']
+    pc = world_cloud(obs, 'top')
+    white = (im.min(2)>165) & ((im.max(2).astype(int)-im.min(2).astype(int))<40)
+    box = (pc[:,:,0]>-.14)&(pc[:,:,0]<.14)&(pc[:,:,1]>-.14)&(pc[:,:,1]<.21)&(pc[:,:,2]>.67)&(pc[:,:,2]<.85)
+    p = pc[white&box]
+    return np.median(p,axis=0),len(p)
+
+def qpos(obs):
+    return np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][:29], float)
+
+def command(r, q, duration=.7, cameras=['top']):
+    return r.submit('joint_position',np.asarray(q),dt=duration,cameras=cameras,video='none',include_depth=True)
+
+def observe(r, cameras=['top']):
+    return r.get_obs(cameras=cameras,include_depth=True)
+
+def calibration(r, obs):
+    q0=qpos(obs); p0,n0=hand_center(obs)
+    print('initial center',p0,n0,flush=True)
+    J=[]
+    for j in range(7):
+        qp=q0.copy(); qp[j]+=.06
+        op=command(r,qp,.7)
+        p,n=hand_center(op)
+        J.append((p-p0)/.06)
+        print('probe',j,'p',p,'n',n,'J',J[-1],flush=True)
+        obs=command(r,q0,.7)
+        p0,n0=hand_center(obs)
+        print('return',p0,n0,flush=True)
+    J=np.array(J).T
+    np.savez('/app/output/calibration.npz',q=q0,p=p0,J=J)
+    return obs,J
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    r=Robot(); obs=observe(r)
+    obs,J=calibration(r,obs)
+    print('J',J,flush=True)
*** End Patch";
